description: Use this when the user requests an optional isolated text AI receptionist test. Accepts salonId and a test message. Saves a test proposal and returns its change ID and preview; it does not run the test yet. After confirmation, beautyos_apply_change runs the isolated test using the existing AI allowance. Customer changes, booking writes, notifications and custom write tools are blocked during the test. A successful test does not verify real-channel delivery.
name: beautyos_agent_test_prepare
title: Preview agent test
